classroom.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
classroom.grades.title: My grades
classroom.grades.intro: Scores your trainer has published. If you think one is wrong, appeal it within 7 days.
classroom.appeal.reasonHelp: Say what you think was marked wrongly.
classroom.appeal.already: You have already appealed this score.
classroom.appeal.state.open: appeal open, waiting for your trainer
classroom.appeals.title: Appeals inbox
classroom.appeals.intro: Learners' appeals with the evidence pack. Decide each one or leave it; an appeal not handled in 7 days is escalated.
classroom.appeals.scoreRange: The score must be between 0 and {max}.
classroom.doubt.title: Doubt queue
classroom.doubt.intro: Ask what is unclear. Upvote the doubts you share; the most upvoted come first.
classroom.roster.title: Class roster
classroom.roster.intro: Everyone enrolled in the class. Use the drop switch when someone leaves; you can undo it.
classroom.roster.restored: {name} is back: restored to team {team} with repository access.
classroom.drop.title: Drop {name}?
classroom.drop.leave: They leave the attendance roll and live quiz.
classroom.dropped.notice: You have been dropped from this class, so you are no longer enrolled: you are off the attendance roll and the live quiz. Ask your trainer if this is a mistake.
classroom.drop.undoNote: Switching back restores team and repository access; tickets stay reassigned.
classroom.acc.title: Accommodations
classroom.acc.intro: If you need extra time on timed work, ask for an accommodation. An admin approves it.
classroom.acc.sent: Request sent. An admin will review it.
classroom.acc.invalid: Enter a multiplier between 1 and 3 and a reason.
classroom.acc.approvedNow: Approved: your Shift and exam timers use {n}x the normal limit.
classroom.acc.admin.title: Accommodation requests
classroom.acc.admin.intro: Approve a request and the learner's Shift and exam timers show the extended limit.
classroom.analysis.title: Item analysis
classroom.analysis.intro: How each question performed. Weak questions are flagged: too hard, too easy, or not separating strong from weak learners.
classroom.misc.title: Suggested misconceptions
classroom.misc.intro: Wrong answers many learners gave. Accept one to add it to the day's explain-it-back checklist.
classroom.misc.label: Misconception wording
classroom.pkg.title: Check a changed package
classroom.pkg.intro: Upload a changed package to see which days and questions would change before you replace the current one.
classroom.pkg.failed: That file could not be read as a package.
classroom.pkg.noCurrent: No package is published for this class yet, so every day is new.
classroom.pkg.question: Question {change}: {text}
